Tiszabecs Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tiszabecs, Hungary

Not demolished. Jews were permitted to settle in Tiszabecs from the first half of the 19th century, peaking at 107 residents by 1880 before declining to 72 by 1941. The community joined the Orthodox stream after 1869's Schism. Following Germany's occupation of Hungary, local Jews were deported to Auschwitz at the end of May 1944; two men and five women returned afterward but soon left, and the community was never re-established. This cemetery, established in the 1830s and now part of the local municipal cemetery, holds tombstones through 1941.
